codeFindings.desc: Path Traversal (Zip Slip) vulnerability when uncompressing student archive submissions.
Code Injection: Student test runner executes arbitrary shell commands outside container root.
SQL injection vulnerability in grade export query filtering by course section.
XSS in formula preview allowing script execution via malicious MathJax string.
Static RSA private key used to sign LTI 1.3 JWT tokens committed in repo.
Missing CSRF verification on course add/drop enrollment action.
Exam lockdown check can be bypassed by spoofing user-agent header string.
FERPA Violation: Student GPA and exam scores logged to unencrypted console stream.
God class: CourseSection contains 80 fields and 35 lifecycle hooks.
Recursive database query fetching deeply nested forum comment replies.
Magic numbers for container memory and time limits.
Non-vectorized embedding computation processing one student document at a time.
Weak password policy allows sequential digits for guest user accounts.
Internal video slice segment fetching allows HTTP fallback.
Duplicated letter grade conversion thresholds in two different grading modules.
Dead code: Legacy flash-based webcam proctoring check deprecated in 2023.
In-memory compression of 2GB student assignment batch crashes worker node.
SSRF vulnerability when fetching remote LTI 1.3 tool icon and manifest.
Detailed university LDAP identity provider hostnames leaked in SAML response.
Complex regular expressions for profanity filter causing catastrophic backtracking.

vulnerabilities.title: Zip Slip File Overwrite via Student Submissions
vulnerabilities.desc: Unchecked entry paths in ZIP files allow overwriting system files outside upload folder.

vulnerabilities.title: Remote Code Execution in Autograder Container
vulnerabilities.desc: Flawed sandbox isolation permits student test scripts to escape to the host container.

vulnerabilities.title: SQL Injection in Gradebook CSV Export
vulnerabilities.desc: Raw parameter concatenation in course section query permits student grade modification.

vulnerabilities.title: Stored XSS in Forum LaTeX MathJax Rendering
vulnerabilities.desc: Malicious script execution in discussion threads accessed by professors and students.

vulnerabilities.title: Static LTI 1.3 Private Signing Key Committed
vulnerabilities.desc: Static RSA private key in repo permits forging LTI grade updates to university registrar.

vulnerabilities.title: SSRF in LTI Deep Linking Resource Preview
vulnerabilities.desc: LTI tool configuration endpoint fetches URLs in internal university network.

vulnerabilities.title: FERPA Violation via Cleartext Student GPA Logging
vulnerabilities.desc: Academic records and grades logged to standard output without redaction.

vulnerabilities.title: User-Agent Proctoring Lockdown Bypass
vulnerabilities.desc: Proctoring security mode deactivated by spoofing custom browser user-agent.

vulnerabilities.title: Cross-Site Request Forgery on Course Drop/Add
vulnerabilities.desc: Unauthorized enrollment changes possible via malicious external link.

vulnerabilities.title: Internal LDAP Server Information Exposure
vulnerabilities.desc: SAML authentication failures expose university directory server addresses.
